desc_lfm_album: This album is a solo project by Mike Patton and is one of his weirder and harder to listen to albums, yet fans may still appreciate his efforts. There are no musical instruments on the album. Mike Patton created this album from a variety of vocal and microphone techniques and overdubs. .
desc_lfm_artist:
Michael Allan Patton (born January 27, 1968, in Eureka, California) is an American singer, songwriter, composer, multi-instrumentalist, and video game voice actor, best known as the lead singer of the rock band Faith No More from 1988 to Present. He has also handled lead vocals and composed music for Mr. Bungle, Tomahawk, Lovage, Fantômas, The Dillinger Escape Plan, Moonchild Trio, Peeping Tom and many others.

Patton has earned critical praise for his diverse vocals
